item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-E003","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Amnesty’s Bangladesh country page states that the Cyber Security Act of 2023 continued to apply; its urgent-action listings identify a student detained for organizing a webinar and a journalist detained while reporting on rising living costs in 2023.","notes":["The excerpt confirms continued application of the Act but does not characterize it as a restrictive framework."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-E007","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Freedom House states that the Awami League consolidated political power through sustained harassment of opposition actors and critical media and by co-opting state institutions during its 15 years in power; it rates Bangladesh Partly Free.","notes":["The excerpt does not state that the 2024 election followed this pattern."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Freedom House lists Bangladesh as having restricted networks, blocked social media and websites, pro-government commentators, and arrested users; it records the parliamentary election date as January 7, 2024.","notes":["The excerpt does not link these internet-freedom indicators causally to the Hasina-era political environment."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
